beats_top.why: The #1 result is a 2019 opinion column about one residential case with old prices; ours gives current 2026-27 official rates, cost per swipe at several usage levels, break-even counts against the official $16.80 door price, and what to do by situation with the current deadline.
changes: Optional: the intro's '$15 to $19 a swipe at full use' leaves out Unlimited; say it covers the capped plans, and that Unlimited at full use depends on meals eaten.
Optional: confirm the leave-of-absence proration wording against the FAQ.
